requirement.statement: In AEO Hindsighting, the Companion View on Category Recap > Cat Summary (BU and TD) and Size Views > SKU View (BU) shows a different product image for the same scope and the same Level (Department / Super Class / ERP Class), and the Cat Summary image is not the top seller. Explain how each image is chosen (and whether BU vs TD differ), make the rule consistent across both screens, and ideally pick the #1 style color by Net Sls $ (net_sls_r).
requirement.acceptance: Taken from the ticket's own Expectation section: at minimum, consistent image logic at levels above style on Cat Summary (TD + BU) and SKU View (BU); ideally the image is the #1 Net Sls $ style color in scope. Operationally: for the same scope and Level, both cards show the first row of Style Color Review > Grid View sorted by Net Sls $ descending (first row per group for Super Class / ERP Class).

prior_art.why_relevant: Style-level image in Style Review (Grid View, TY/LY Grid View) fixed to pick the style's #1 stylecolor by sum(net_sls_r) from p_history_agg. SUP-4610 applies the same Net Sls $ rule to the group-level companion cards, adding exchange_rate (to match the grid's Net Sls $) and a deterministic tie-breaker.

Origin of the COMPANION_METRICS tables and INV_LOCATION eComm/Store split inside the same two companion pivots; its Net Sls $ calculation (p_history_agg x INV_LOCATION x currency_conv) is the pattern the fix reuses.

hypotheses.cause: Image ranking ignores the location scope (sku_temp_flow_flag has no location filter), so the Cat Summary winner reflects other locations.
hypotheses.ruled_out_because: North America is the only AEO location; all-locations equals the scope.

hypotheses.cause: SKU View favours items with few sizes because their units are concentrated in fewer SKUs.
hypotheses.ruled_out_because: sku_temp_flow_flag does not split units by size; every SKU row carries the stylecolor total, so the top SKU row equals the stylecolor's real units.

hypotheses.cause: Bottom Up and Top Down use different image logic.
hypotheses.ruled_out_because: Same model and pivot; TD viewdefn only adds Level options.

hypotheses.cause: The companion Order By dropdown drives the image.
hypotheses.ruled_out_because: The pivot's LIMIT 1 BY always ordered by ttl_net_sls_u; Order By only re-sorts the companion list.

hypotheses.cause: Both pivots rank by Net Sls U from sku_temp_flow_flag, which repeats stylecolor units on every SKU row; Cat Summary sums those rows (units x size count, favouring many-size items) while SKU View takes the single top SKU row (real units). Two different rules, neither Net Sls $.

root_cause.statement: HistoryGrid_Companion (Cat Summary) and HistoryGridSKU_Companion (SKU View) chose top_stylecolor by ttl_net_sls_u = sum(net_sls_u) from aeo_sku_temp_flow_flag. That table holds stylecolor-grain units repeated on every SKU row. Cat Summary grouped by stylecolor, so the score was units x SKU count (CO0123_4882_064: 81,360 x 49 = 3,986,640 beat CO1229_5168_064: 144,254 x 13); SKU View grouped by SKU, so it picked the real top seller by units. The two screens therefore applied different unit-based rules and neither matched the requested Net Sls $ rule.

changes: aeo-configs/pivot/HistoryGrid_Companion.pivotdefn — TOP_PRODUCT: add rank_net_sls_r = ifNull(sum(net_sls_r * exchange_rate), 0) per stylecolor from p_history_agg (ty weeks, LEAF_PRODLIFE, LOCATION, LEAF_CLUSTER; INV_LOCATION -> currency_conv) via ANY LEFT JOIN ON p.product; hierarchy join USING -> ON; pick = ORDER BY <level>, rank_net_sls_r desc, stylecolor LIMIT 1 BY <level>
aeo-configs/pivot/HistoryGridSKU_Companion.pivotdefn — same change; dollar subquery keyed on PRODUCT.stylecolor (PRODUCT.product is the SKU here), p.stylecolor selected explicitly
Unchanged: COMPANION_METRICS, SCCOUNT_PRODUCT, agg_shp_u, history_product_ty*.ftl, pivot output columns

knowledge_gained.technical: Group-level companion images come from the pivot column named in the model's additionalDecorations (top_stylecolor), which darwin's AdditionalLevelPostProcessor maps to the stylecolor level so attribute:img:name resolves; the rule is the pivot's ORDER BY ... LIMIT 1 BY <level>. AEO aeo_sku_temp_flow_flag.net_sls_u is stylecolor-grain repeated on every SKU row, so summing it across SKUs multiplies by size count; rank stylecolors from p_history_agg with sum(net_sls_r * exchange_rate) and the grid's filters, add a stylecolor tie-breaker, and remember PRODUCT.product is the SKU in *_sku pivots. ClickHouse here rejects two JOIN...USING at one level; use ON with aliases.
knowledge_gained.functional: At Department / Super Class / ERP Class the companion card photo is the visual face of the group; planners expect it to be the group's top seller by Net Sales $ for the selected scope, matching the #1 item in Style Color Review > Grid View and identical on every screen showing that group (same rule SUP-4193 set for the style-level photo).
